english.title: Channel tunnel - continue to fail to comply with direction under article 15
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) having been convicted on **(..SPECIFY DATE OF CONVICTION..) of an offence under article 15(8)(a) of the Channel Tunnel (Security) Order 1994, continued, without reasonable excuse, in the failure to comply with

(A)_[a direction]_
(B)_[a requirement specified in a direction]_

given to you under article 15(1) of the said order
english.legislation: Contrary to article 15(10) of the Channel Tunnel (Security) Order 1994.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding one-tenth of level five on the standard scale for each day on which the failure continues.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
